slides.title:
How I'd explain
Power BI to a
5-year-old
slides.sub: 12 Power BI ideas. One school day.

cells.kid: Tip all your toys out of the box so you can see what you have.
Wash the muddy vegetables before Mummy cooks them.
Match every sock with its partner using the colour.
The sun sits in the middle. The planets go around it.
At the end of the match, count the total goals.
Write a name tag on every single crayon, one by one.
Only show me the red sweets, please.
Same sweets, but look at them through a red window.
Draw the numbers as a picture so anyone can read it.
Like the car dashboard: speed and fuel, all on one screen.
Get today's newspaper, not last week's.
Stick your drawing on the class notice board for all to see.
